title: Budgets
description: The most specific budget applies (team → project → organization). Unlimited scopes do not inherit a parent cap. In-flight runs may slightly exceed a soft cap.
modeDegrade: Degrade — use a cheaper model over cap
storageCapHelp: Blocks uploads for this scope after the cap is reached (in any mode).
blockLiveRequests: Also block live requests from people (off by default; only automations are throttled)
fallbackModel: Fallback model (used after reaching the cap)
deleteBody: This removes the budget for {{scope}}. You can create it again later.
chooseScope: Choose a project or team for this budget.
invalidCap: Caps must be non-negative numbers. Leave blank for no cap.
invalidThreshold: The warning threshold must be between 1 and 100.
fallbackModelRequired: Degrade mode requires a fallback model.
invalidStorageCap: The storage cap must be a non-negative number of GB. Leave blank for no cap.

pricing.title: Model pricing
pricing.descriptionBefore: Rates per million tokens convert usage into cost. Use the exact model name, or
pricing.descriptionAfter: as a fallback for the provider. Saving the same model again replaces its current rate.
pricing.repriceTitle: Recalculate cost for usage recorded before pricing was configured
pricing.requiredFields: Provider and model pattern are required.
pricing.invalidRates: Rates must be non-negative USD amounts per million tokens. Leave blank to skip.
